target.name: BlackRock Investment Quality Municipal Trust, Inc.

acquirer.name: BlackRock MuniYield Quality Fund III, Inc.

listed_quote.quote: BlackRock Investment Quality Municipal Trust, Inc. (NYSE: BKN) and BlackRock MuniYield Quality Fund III, Inc. (NYSE: MYI)

announcement.quote: have approved the mergers of each of MIY, MPA, BHV and BKN with and into MYI, with MYI continuing as the surviving Fund

deals.notes: The same filing also proposed MIY, MPA and BHV into MYI (not recorded here; they are other funds). The excerpts never state how the BKN-into-MYI merger ended. The BKN merger was contingent on a VMTP refinancing. A later proposal (January 2025) puts BKN into a different acquirer, MQY, but no excerpt says the MYI proposal was replaced or terminated, so outcome is left null.

announcement.quote: BlackRock Investment Quality Municipal Trust, Inc. (NYSE: BKN), BlackRock MuniYield Quality Fund II, Inc. (NYSE: MQT) and BlackRock MuniYield Fund, Inc. (NYSE: MYD) into BlackRock MuniYield Quality Fund, Inc. (NYSE: MQY), with MQY continuing as the surviving Fund

deals.notes: Also covers MQT and MYD into MQY (other funds). Later filings (425 of 2025-06-09 and 2025-08-12, PRE 14A of 2025-08-08 with a title naming MQY reorg) show the BKN-MQY proposal continuing to a shareholder vote, but no excerpt states a result.

problems: Excerpts of later filings are compact (first lines and few passages); no completion, termination or vote result for either BKN proposal appears in them.
